༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khyad par rnam 'byed ha nu man+tha zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mthu stobs thogs med 'bar ba'i mtshun za yis// bgegs rkyen mun nag bsti ba'i gnas phrogs nas// phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'od kyis 'jig rten khams// yongs khyab bla ma ye shes me lhas skyongs// bsnyen sogs dag par bgyis pa'i rig sngags 'chang*// don gnyis sgrub la 'jug gi gzhan pas min// dar babs skyes bu'i rtsal gyis bteg pa'i khur// chen po bus pas mi 'os pa min nam// gzungs sngags zab mo'i yongs rtse bzlas pa'i grangs// tshad du yong ye phyin pa'i rnal 'byor par// sreg blugs cho ga'i lag pa 'di yod na// dngos grub snye ma len la dka' ba ci// de la 'dir bya ba'i rgyud rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha mchog rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'i gang zag gis rang gzhan gyi don du las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ spyir 'di dag la 'gro mgon 'phags pas/ cho ga ni spyi dang mtshungs pa nyid do// de lta na'ang khyad par cung zad yod pa ni 'chad pa po'i ngag las shes par bya'o zhes khyad par brjod pa tsam ma gtogs spyi 'gro gzhan ltar bya bar gsungs pa ltar brjod pa la/ tshul 'di'i sbyor ba thab dang yo byad bsham// dngos gzhi bdag bskyed phal mchog me lha mchod// rjes ni mchod cing bzod par gsol te gshegs// bkra shis dbyangs kyis mtha' mar brgyan bya'o// zhes pa ltar gyi thog mar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi sbyor ba la/ sa gzhi mnyam par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas mtho gang gi tshad kyis zlum por bskor bas khru gang 'byung zhing*/ de'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi pa lan gnyis kyis bskor bas kha khyer dang mu ran 'byung*/ tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzom pa nas zur bzhir mtshan ma btsal te stegs bu gru bzhir gdab/

mu ran la rdo rje kha zums pa'i phreng ba dang*/ phyi rol gyi stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po la bcad tshon dmar skyas bya/ thab dbus nas sum gcig lte ba dang*/ sum gnyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad bya/ dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje mdun mtshan dkar po nub tu 'ong ba bri'o// gnyis pa yo byad bsham pa ni/ mu ran gyi steng nas bud shing 'o ma can nam/ srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba skam po zlum por brtsig de'i nang 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor me tshang gi ting lo che ba bzhag nub nas sgrub pa po zhal shar du phyogs par 'gyur ba'i stan nang tshang can dkar po btings pa'i mdun du me yol pha gu la dkar rtsis byugs pa dang*/ mdun du stegs kyi khar rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar dang blugs gzar kha sbyar ba dang bsang chu 'thor yab bcas bzhag sgrub pa po'i g.yas logs nas rim par yam shing 'o ma can gyi rigs mar khu/ til lam yungs kar te bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo de gsum gyis chog par bshad/ de'ang bsreg rdzas so sor 'os pa rnams 'jig rten pa'i me lha la sngon du nyer gcig lta bu ji tsam 'bul ba de'i grangs dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha la brgya rtsa dang lhag ma bdun sogs gang dgos bcas rnams tshar gnyis so sor bshams nas byin rlabs dus gcig tu byed pa ni phyag len shin tu legs pa mngon/ g.yon logs nas chu gnyis nyer spyod dang 'das gtor dang me lha'i zlum gtor gnyis bsham mo// dngos gzhi la gsum gyi dang por bdag bskyed pa ni/ phyi dro'i dus la sogs par zhwa gos dkar pos brgyan te skyil krung ngam rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam dang ldan pas rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib la sogs pa zhi bar byed pa'i sems dang ldan pas 'khod de/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs skyabs su 'gro ba nas brtsams te bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'i bar gzhung bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa phal pa'i me lha mchod pa la/

thog mar bsang chu na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa sogs yang snying lan bdun bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te bzhag 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar bya'o// de nas rgyun zhag gi me'am 'o ma can gyi shing gtsubs pa las byung ba'i mes sbar ba'i dpal 'bar lag pa gnyis kyis gus pa'i tshul gyis bzung nas thab la g.yas nas zlum por lan gsum du bskor zhing*/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod cing me tshang du gzhug la rtswa skam sogs dang bcas pas me sbar/ de nas dgang blugs byang chub mchog gi khu tshur gyis bzung nas blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi khar reg pas mar khu bud shing la khyab par blugs te me gso/ skabs 'dir me pra ngan na bsang chu yang snying brjod pas gtor/ de nas bsang chus rdzas rnams la gtor zhing*/ yang snying gis bsang*/ swa bhā sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon la sogs pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da swā hā'i bar dang*/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās 'bru rnams bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās sbyangs te byin gyis brlab bo// thab sngar bzhin bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan cing*/ lha rdzas bud shing gi rtsig pa dang bcas pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur par bsam zhing hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas thab kyi dbus su pad+ma'i gdan la raṃ las byung ba'i me lha sku mdog dkar po ra skyes la zhon pa/

zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis kyis dbyu gu rtse gsum pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ drang srong gi cha lugs can/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes brjod pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dam tshig par gnyis su med par thim par bsam mo// ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥzhes brjod cing thab kyi mthar phyogs mtshams brgyad du g.yas skor du dgram mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi khu tshur gyis bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi kha'i raṃ la phog nas mar khu gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar dgang blugs gnyis kha sbyar te/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī pyā di pya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya swā hā zhes pas me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod cing*/

rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras// me lha'i rgyal po mchog tu dbang bskur zhing*// shes rab me yis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas len cing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul ba'i tshul bya ste/ de'ang rdzas thams cad 'bul sngags/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa 'ba' zhig gis te yam shing lan bdun nam nyer gcig phul mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes gdags/ sbyin bdag gi don du bya ba'i tshe spel tshig gang 'tshams kha bsgyur shes par bya'o// de bzhin du mar dang*/ til lam yungs kar rnams kyang sngags de nyid dang mthar spel tshig sbyar ba bcas phul/ de nas mchod bstod sngar bzhin byas la/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu phul/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes dang me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa mchog gi me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i klong du paṃ las pad+ma sogs nas rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa'i bar gyis srung ba'i 'khor lo lha dang bcas pa sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ de'i mtha' skor du rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang bcas par dmigs la/ de thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam zhing brjod/ gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha dad med par dmigs la/ gzar bu gnyis blangs nas lha rnams zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje sogs sngar bzhin bsams la/

yang snying lan gcig gi rjes su/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā lan bdun gyis mar khu phul mthar/ a dī byā di bya sogs dang bdag gi tshe 'khor ba sogs spel tshig gong bzhin brjod/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ de nas spro na/ mchod yon phal cher la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas so so'i kha bsgyur ba dang bcas pas shab+da'i bar dharma ra ṇi rol mor bcas pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhes sogs kyis bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams bya'o// de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas thams cad yang snying 'ba' zhig gis brgya rtsa re dbul zhing sde tshan re'i mthar spel tshig gdags/ de'ang yam shing 'bar ba'i me la'o// zhu ba'i rdzas zhal dang gong bu'i rdzas phyag tu 'bul lo// de nas til mdun du bzhag pa la bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa la sogs pa kaṃ yig nag po'i rnam par bsdus nas bstim/ slar yang de'i steng a yig dkar po zhig bsams te/ de'i 'od zer til la phog pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa lha'i zhal du phul bsams la/ yang snying brgya rtsa re'i mtshams su spel tshig btags la bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i til 'bul/ sgrub g.yog gis me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi mar dang yam shing gis me rgyun gso/ slar yang byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags gong ltar spel ba'i ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod cing bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya'o// gtor ma chab kyis bran la 'das gtor bum chog gi skabs ltar phul nas mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang 'dod don zhu/ spro na cha gsum gtor ma'ang btang la/

yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ thab kyi thal ba nas srin lag gis cung zad blangs pa dpral bar bskus te/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// rjes la gnyis kyi dang po mchod cing bzod par gsol ba ni/ thab tu mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg par phul la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes dang*/ slar yang 'bar ba me lha'i rnam par gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs phul mthar/ byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su phul/ me lha'i gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥta thā ga ta sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags re re'i sngon du 'gro bas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod la/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags lhag chad du gyur pa'i nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa lta bu 'dod don gang yin zhus/ bdag las dang po pa'i gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga 'khrul pa dang*/ yo byad dman pa la sogs pa skyon du gyur pa thams cad bzod cing sbyang bar mdzad du gsol lo// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa gshegs gsol bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa ni/ lag pa gnyis kyi mtheb srin se gol dang bcas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes brjod pas ye shes pa rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/

dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje rnam 'joms 'grub gyur nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas gdab/ che ba'i che mchog la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mtha' brgyan/ thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la ni thal ba 'phral du 'phyags btub kyi/ mchog sgrub pa la ni me nam mnal gyi bar mi bsgul/ me mnal nas thal ba phyags la rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung ngam ri rtse la sogs par bskyal lo// shing 'phel 'bar ba'i khyim du ye shes lha// sreg blugs mgron du gnyer byas de nas bzung*// sdig sgrib nye zho'i phyogs brgya cig car du// zhi byed las kyi pho nya dang po yin// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i zhi ba'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// //de nyid gzhir bzhag ri klung gser ldan ma'i// dus kyi dga' ston ji bzhin sde bzhi'i dpal// kun nas ches cher rgyas byed sreg blugs kyi// khyad par cho ga'i ha nu man+thas 'byed// gnyis pa rang gzhan don du rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ cho ga'i 'gros phal cher zhi ba gzhir byas nas/ 'dir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams brjod par bya'o// de'ang gnas yid du 'ong bar sa stegs yangs par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas khru gang gi tshad kyis phyogs bzhir mtshan ma byas la/ de'i bar gyi srad bu de g.yon pas mtshan ma'i steng bzung nas g.yas pas zur bzhi'i thig la mtshan ma btsal/ de'i steng thig bzhi btab pas thab khung dang*/ slar yang de'i steng sor brgyad pa gnyis bskyed pa'i mtshan ma btsal te thig gnyis re btab pas kha khyer dang mu ran 'byung*/ thab nang gi dbus nas sum gcig zlum por bskor ba lte ba dang*/ sum gnyis bskor bas pad+ma 'dab brgyad bya/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog ser po la bcad tshon li khris bya/ mu ran la rin po che'i phreng ba bri/ lha gnas su sna tshogs rdo rje bri bar bya'o// gnyis pa yo byad ni/

kha khyer gyi steng nas bud shing 'bras bu can gyi shing ser zhing dri zhim po'i dbus kyi cha las byung ba'am/ med na srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba skam po gru bzhir brtsig shar lhor me tshang dang*/ lhor sgrub pa po'i gdan sogs bsham/ g.yas logs nas yam shing 'bras bu can gyi sbom phra gung mo tsam/ srid du khru gang pa/ rtse mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags pa brgya rtsa brgyad sogs dang*/ mar dang*/ tshe rgyas ba la dūr ba'i myu gu/ longs spyod rgyas pa la zho mar mngar gsum sogs sngags pa'i zas mchog khyim gyi 'byor pa rgyas pa la 'bru sna tshogs/ shes rab rgyas pa la dri bzang po dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i ri lu rnams skabs su gang 'tsham bsham/ g.yon logs nas mchod gtor sngar bzhin bsham mo// dngos gzhi'i dang po ni/ snga dro'i dus su rang nyid gos rgyan ser pos brgyan te/ rang gzhan gyi tshe bsod nams la sogs pa rgyas par byas te tshim pa'i bsam pas/ kha byang du phyogs par sa 'ja' li la sogs par khyel 'dug gis bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod la bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo// gnyis pa phal pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ thog mar bsang chu byin gyis brlabs pa nas lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar bslab pa'i bar 'dra/ dpal 'bar thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par g.yas nas bskor ba sogs nas/ dgang blugs khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis brkyangs pa'am/ de gnyis rtse sbyar ba rin chen khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas bzung ba ma gtogs gzhan rnams 'dra/ thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po gru bzhi pa rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa/ mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan cing*/ lha rdzas bud shing gi rtsig pa dang bcas pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa nas me lha sku mdog ser po sogs dang 'od zer ser po 'phro ba zhes pa dang*/

spel tshig gi tshe/ bdag gam sbyin bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes sogs gdags pa ma gtogs 'dra'o// gsum pa mchog gi me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i klong du paṃ las pad+ma sogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes pa ma gtogs 'dra ba las/ de thams cad 'dzum zhing tshim pa/ 'od zer ser po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod la sogs pa rgyas pa'i las mdzad ces pa dang*/ spel tshig ni/ bdag dang sbyin bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams sogs brjod pa dang*/ rdzas ni til gyi tshab zas mchog 'ong ba ma gtogs 'dra/ grangs brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ rdzas kyi gtso bo zas mchog la grangs bzung ba dang*/ spel tshig rgyas pa byed pa ma gtogs gzhan thams cad 'dra'o// rjes kyi skabs 'dod gsol la me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod dang dbang phyug la sogs pa legs pa'i tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa tsam las gzhan thams cad zhi ba ltar bya'o// gzi brgya 'bar ba mtshun za'i dkyil 'khor du// lha mchog gya nom mchod pas mnyes byas pas// tshe dpal bsod nams stobs sogs rdzogs ldan dpal// skyed byed las kyi dpag bsam gnyis pa yin// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rab rgyas sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// //zhi ba gzhir gzhag chos dang srid 'byor gyis// khengs ldan brtan pa phun tshogs skyes dang bcas// dbang byed me na ka 'dra'i sreg blugs kyi// khyad par cho ga'i ha nu man+thas 'byed// gsum pa rang gzhan gyi don du dbang gi sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ cho ga'i 'gros phal cher zhi ba gzhir byas nas/ 'dir khyad par rnams brjod par bya ste/ de'ang gnas yid du 'ong bar sa stegs la thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas shar du sor gsum 'phags pa'i sar thab dbus kyi mtshan ma byas la khru phyed kyi tshad kyis/

g.yon pas dbus kyi mtshan ma'i steng du srad bu bzung*/ g.yas pas me nas dbang ldan bar gyi thig la reg par g.yas skor du bskor/ slar yang de'i khar sor bzhi bzhi bskyed pa lan gnyis bskor bas kha khyer dang mu ran te/ shar gyi thig rtse so sor sbrel ba'i thig btab pas zla gam gyi dbyibs 'byung*/ nub kyi tshangs thig dang zlum skor phrad pa nas dbus bar gyi tshad des zur bzhir mtshan ma byas pa'i steng nas thig gru bzhir btab/ de'i khar yang sor bzhi bskyed la zur bzhir mtshan ma dang thig btab pas thab stegs so// thab nang pad+ma sogs zhi ba dang 'dra/ gzhi tshon dmar po la bcad tshon dkar pos bya/ kha khyer mu ran gang rung la pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan par bya'o// gnyis pa yo byad ni/ bud shing ni me tog dmar po can nam/ med na nags kyi lci bas zla gam du brtsig shar du sgrub pa po'i stan nang tshang can sogs 'dra/ rang gi g.yas logs nas/ yam shing*/ seng ldeng*/ mdzo mo shing*/ se ba/ shug pa sogs dmar po rtsi ma nyams pa/ rked pa'i cha las byung ba/ sbom phra sor mo tsam dang srid du chag do pa/ mar ni smug rtsis kha bsgyur ba tsha ba'i mar khu cung zad bsres pa/ rdzas kyi gtso bo me tog dmar po'am/ 'bras bu dmar po/ med na tsan+dan dmar po sogs kyis kha bsgyur ba/ g.yon logs nas gi wang*/ gur gum/ tsan+dan dmar po sogs btab pa'i mchod yon dang*/ chu gtsang gi zhabs bsil la sogs pa'i nyer spyod dang*/ gtor ma smug rtsis byugs pa bsham/ dngos gzhi'i dang po ni/ phyi dro'i dus su gos rgyan dmar pos brgyan te/ rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa dbang du byas te/ byang chub kyi lam la dgod par bya snyam pas chags shing 'dun pa'i bsam pas kha nub tu bltas te pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod la bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo// gnyis pa phal pa'i me lha mchod pa la/

bsang chu byin gyis brlabs pa sogs 'dra/ me ni rgyal po'am/ smad 'tshong ma'am/ chang 'tshong ma'am/ btso blag mkhan gyi me'am/ kun tu rgyus lam du bus pa'i mes bya/ dpal 'bar thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par g.yas nas bskor ba sogs 'dra/ dgang blugs khu tshur bcangs pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar ba pad+ma'i 'dab ltar byas pa pad+ma'i khu tshur gyis bzung ba ma gtogs 'dra/ thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i dbang gi thab khung dmar por zla gam rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa/ mu ran la pad+ma'i phreng bas mtshan cing*/ lha rdzas bud shing gi rtsig pa dang bcas pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa nas me lha sku mdog dmar po sogs nas/ 'od zer mang po 'phro ba zhes pa dang*/ spel tshig gi tshe/ rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i skye 'gro mang po wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes gdags pa ma gtogs gzhan 'dra'o// gsum pa mchog gi me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i klong du pam̐ las pad+ma sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa ma gtogs 'dra ba las/ de thams cad chags pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing*/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas yul 'khor dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i skye 'gro thams cad chags shing 'dun pa'i las mdzad ces dang*/ dbang gi spel tshig gdags pa dang*/ rdzas ni til gyi tshab me tog dmar po bya ba dang*/ grangs ni lnga bcu dang*/ rdzas kyi gtso bo me tog la grangs bzung ba ma gtogs gzhan thams cad 'dra'o// rjes kyi tshe/ 'dod gsol la me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa skye 'gro mang po chags shing 'dun par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa tsam las gzhan thams cad zhi ba ltar bya'o// srid zhi'i me lha dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal gyi// yid bsgyur dmar ba'i mkhur tshos ngom tsam nas// stobs 'byor che dgu'i snying gi mdza' na mo// 'gugs byed las kyi 'jo sgeg gsum pa yin// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dbang gi sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to//

//zhi ba gzhir bzhag sdang dgra gdon dang bgegs// skad cig gnyis par 'tsho ba rung ngam zhes// za byed zhugs lce rkyong ba sregs blugs kyi// khyad par cho ga'i ha nu man+thas 'byed// bzhi pa bstan pa rin po che dang sems can yongs la sdang zhing tho btsams pa'i dgra bgegs sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs tshar gcad pa'i phyir drag po'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ cho ga'i 'gros phal cher zhi ba gzhir byas nas/ 'dir khyad par rnams brjod par bya ste/ sa chog byas pa'i sa gzhir thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas sor drug dang sor mo gcig gi sum gnyis kyi tshad kyis zlum por lan gnyis/ de'i phyir sor drug pa gnyis kyis lan gnyis bskor/ zlum skor gnyis pa dang byang gi tshangs thig 'dzom par g.yon pas srad bu bzung*/ de dang lte ba'i bar gyi tshad des shar nub kyi zlum skor la rtags bya/ byang ngos su de gnyis sbrel ba'i thig btab/ de gnyis dang lho'i tshangs thig zlum thig 'dzom par sbrel ba'i thig btab pas gru gsum 'byung ba thab nang dang*/ zlum skor phyi ma gnyis kyi steng nas kyang de ltar byas nas thig btab pas kha khyer dang mu ran 'byung ngo*// zlum skor phyi ma'i tshad kyis phyi rol du thab stegs gru bzhir gdab/ nang gi zlum skor dang po'i sum gnyis pad 'dab dang sum gcig gis lte ba bya/ thab kyi gzhi tshon thams cad kha dog nag po la bcad tshon sngo skyas bya/ kha khyer mu ran gang rung la rdo rje rtse gsum pa gdengs pa'i phreng ba dang*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje sngon pos mtshan pa bri/ gnyis pa yo byad ni/ kha khyer gyi steng nas bud shing tsher ma can dang*/ gzhan yang bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs la sogs pa gru gsum du brtsig nang gi shar lhor me tshang gi ting lo bzhag byang du sgrub pa po'i stan sogs 'dra/ de'i g.yas logs nas chu gnyis nyer spyod gtor ma gnyis/ g.yon logs nas yam shing drag po'i shing nag cing 'khyog pa/

dri mi zhim pa rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba/ sbom phra mthe'u chung tsam dang srid sor bcu pa drug cu lhag bcas dang*/ nyer gcig pa'am bdun pa tshan gcig mar ram tsha ba'i mar khu/ rdzas kyi gtso bo yungs kar dang*/ ske tshe/ dug sna tshogs rnams bsham mo// dngos gzhi'i dang po ni/ nyin phyed dang mtshan phyed kyi dus su gos rgyan nag pos brgyan te/ bgegs la sogs pa tshar gcad pa'i bsam pas kha lhor phyogs par rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan pa'am/ yang na g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed krung gi spyod lam gyis 'khod la bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo// gnyis pa phal pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ bsang chu byin gyis brlabs pa sogs 'dra/ me ni gdol pa'am shan pa'i khyim gyi me'am/ rdo'am lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba'i mes sbar ba'i dpal 'bar thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun pa'i gru gsum du g.yon nas lan gsum bskor ba sogs dang*/ dgang blugs lag g.yas g.yon bzlog ste rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcangs/ mdzub mo bsgreng ba'i khro bo'i khu tshur gyis bzung pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams 'dra/ thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las drag po'i thab khung nag po gru gsum pa/ rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa/ mu ran la rdo rje rtse gsum pa rwa gdengs pa'i phreng bas mtshan cing drag po'i bud shing gi rtsig pa dang bcas pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ me lha sku mdog nag po sogs nas 'od zer nag po 'phro zhes pa dang*/ spel tshig gi tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod par byed pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon la tho 'tshams pa'i dgra bgegs zhes sam/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs bar du gcod pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa lta bu skabs su gang bab bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra'o// gsum pa mchog gi me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i klong du pam̐ las pad+ma sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes pa ma gtogs 'dra ba las/

de thams cad gnag cing rab tu khros pa/ 'od zer nag po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las mdzad par gyur ces pa dang*/ drag po'i spel tshig gong ltar dang*/ rdzas ni til gyi tshab yungs kar ske tshe/ dug sna byed pa ma gtogs 'dra/ 'bul ba'i tshe lag pa g.yon pas 'bul ba dang*/ grangs ni drug cu dang*/ rdzas kyi gtso bo dug sna sogs la grangs bzung ba dang*/ drag po'i spel tshig bsgyur ba ma gtogs mchog gi me lha'i dam tshig pa rang la thim pa'i bar thams cad 'dra'o// rjes kyi tshe gzhan 'dra ba las/ 'dod gsol la/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod par byed pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon la tho btsams pa dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs sam/ chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dam nyams sdig can thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol zhes pa tsam las gzhan bkra shis kyi cho gas mtha' brgyan pa'i bar rjes kyi chos thams cad zhi ba dang 'dra bar bya'o// thun mong dngos grub tsam la zhi ba la 'o ma dang*/ rgyas pa la gur gum gyi chu dang*/ dbang la tsan+dan dmar po'i chu dang*/ drag po la dug chus me bsad la 'phral du phyags te thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs la bkra shis kyi me tog gi char dbab par bya'o// chos dang sems can sdang byed tsher ma'i nags// za byed rngam pa'i me lce srid rtse'i bar// 'khyug pas dus mtha'i zhugs kyang sgron me ltar// bgyid pa las kyi dug me bzhi pa'o// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i mngon spyod sreg blugs kyi cho ga bstan zin to// //smras pa/ sngon rabs mkhas pa'i legs bshad a sho kaḥ /nyams blang bde ba'i 'dab phreng ma grol bar// blo gros sgeg mo'i rkang rtses bsnun pa'i 'phral// rnam gsal 'dab brgya dgod pa'i ltad mo byung*// ye shes snang ba dam pas 'og min bar// khyab par gsal ba sreg blugs cho ga yi// ngo mtshar rjes su mnyan phyir mtsho byung ma// longs spyod 'khor lor dgyes dgur rtsen nam snyam// 'dir 'bad rnam dkar dge bas rig sngags 'chang*// bzlas bsgom nus pa grub pa'i gom stabs kyis// ye shes lnga ldan grong du legs phyin nas// sa gsum chos kyi snang chen 'gyed par shog

/ces rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khyad par rnam 'byed ha nu man+tha zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer 'ga' la phan pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa'i gsung rab kyi bzhed pa nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu sbyar ba 'gro la phan par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sreg blugs kyi cho ga ye shes me lce zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhiṃ/ ye shes me 'od dkar gsal 'khyil pa'i klong*// 'dzum dkar nyams kyi rol pas sdig sgrib dang*// bar du gcod pa zhi ba'i las mdzad ma// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo la btud nas// gsang sngags nus pa'i tsha gdung 'bar ba'i kha// mi mthun mun pa za phyir ches glal ba'i// sreg blugs cho ga ye shes me yi lce// bskyod 'dir bla ma mkha' 'gros gnang ba stsol// de la 'dir mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba la sogs pa'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga brtsam pas/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po ni/ yongs su sbyangs pa'i sa gzhi la thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ de'i dbus nas khru phyed pa'i tshad kyis zlum por bskor/ de'i phyi rol du yang sor bzhi pa lan gnyis su bskor ba ni thab dang kha khyer dang mu ran no// de'i phyi rol du thab stegs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ dbus su zlum skor nang ma dang nub kyi tshangs thig 'dzom pa nas lte ba'i bar slebs pa'i srad bu'i tshad kyis zlum skor de nyid kyi g.yas dang g.yon du ji tsam slebs pa'i mtshan ma gnyis byas te/ de gnyis dang shar gyi tshangs thig dang zlum skor nang la 'dzom pa gsum po thig gis gru gsum gyi dbyibs su sbrel lo// de'i nang du'ang ji tsam rigs pa'i tshad kyis me ris kyi thig kyang btab ste chos 'byung me ri dang bcas pa'o// thab kyi gzhi tshon thams cad ni dkar po dang*/

mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba 'dri ba dang*/ bcad tshon rnams dmar skya bya ba sogs spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ me ris kha dog rang mdangs dang*/ chos 'byung sngon po byas pa'i dbus su nyi gdan gyi steng du tshon spungs sngon po dgod do// kha khyer gyi steng nas bud shing skam por brtsigs pa'i nang gi shar lhor ting lo rtswa skam po dang bcas pa bsham mo// thab nub tu sgrub pa po 'dug pa'i mdun du bsang chu 'thor g.yab/ rdo rje dril bu ḍā ma ru/ dgang gzar blugs gzar/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad rnams sta gon bya/ rang gi g.yon du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma gnyis bsham/ rang gi g.yas su yam shing dang*/ mar dang*/ til dang*/ zho mar phye/ gzhan yang 'bras sur dkar gyi me tog smug rtsi dngul chu rin po che sna tshogs brdar ba'i phye ma rnams bsres pa'i zas mchog dang*/ ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi rnams bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i ril bu dang*/ dūr wa dang ku sha rnams 'og tu dgos pa'i grangs dang mthun par bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ phyi dro'i dus su 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ bdag bskyed skyabs 'gro nas/ gdan rang la thim pa'i bar nyams su blang ngo*// de nas bsang chu hūm̐ ring po bdun nam nyer gcig tsam gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ sngags de nyid kyis thab dang rdzas rnams la gtor te bgegs bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil nas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsreg rdzas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlab bo// de nas thab la dmigs te/

oṃ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la hūm̐ ring po yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rtswa gtsang ma dang bcas pa'i yam shing gi rtse la me sbar te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod cing thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor te me tshang du gzhug pas me sbar ro// de nas byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang gzar dang blugs gzar bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg pas bud shing la khyab pa'i mar gyi rgyun blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod pa lan gsum gyis me gso'o// der 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las me lha ra skyes la bcibs pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang pos dbyu gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas gun+dhe 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pas stod g.yogs dang dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yob cing*/ ngag tu/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog

/sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ag+ni ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma pra sā dha kaḥ ka ru ṇ+ya kṛta satwa ar+tha asmin+san+ni hi twa bha wa/ zhes brjod pas spyan drangs te dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas ku sha'i chun po rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a zhes pas thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo// de nas me lha'i ljags las 'od zer byung bas byon zan gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod pa'i rjes su/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la/ oṃ ag+na ye re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ ag+na ye oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas yam shing*/ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig gi mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes dang*/ gnas skabs gzhan du bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang*/ gnod pa thams cad dang*/ gdon thams cad dang*/ dug dang rims nad thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā zhes pa lta bu skabs su gang bab brjod do// de bzhin du sngags de nyid kyis mar dang*/ til dang*/ zas mchog dang*/ mngar gsum gyi ril bu dang*/ dūrba dang*/ ku sha rnams kyang yam shing gi grangs dang mnyam par phul ba'i mthar/ mchod pa dang bstod pa snga ma ltar byas nas mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes dang*/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur par bsam mo// de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed pa dang*/ de'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum zhing zhi ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsams la/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥsogs 'ga' zhig mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ ḍā ki nī singha mu khī ā dī pyā dī pya ma hā shrī ye sogs kyi mthar/

bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sogs spel tshig sbyar ba dang bcas pa bdun tshan gsum gyis byon zan dbul la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ ḍā ki nī singha mu khī sa pa ri wā ra re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi dang bcas pa'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod do// de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams gsang sngags yi ge bcu bzhi pa 'ba' zhig brgya rtsa brgyad phul ba'i mthar/ sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i don du til mdun du bzhag la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las sdig sgrib thams cad yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas brgyud mar byung ste sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi gzugs su byung ste mdun gyi til la thim pas/ til zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir gyur pa lha'i zhal du phul bas bdag rgyud kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag snyam du bsam zhing*/ yi ge bcu bzhi pa brgya stong la sogs pa spel tshig dang bcas pa brjod cing phul bas grangs bzung ngo*// slar yang gong gi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha'i byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos pa la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor ba dang*/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyis bsang sbyangs nas brtsams te/ 'di nyid kyi mchod pa'i cho ga kho bos byas pa las 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ spro na/ yid 'ong lhung lhung snyan pa'i chab sgra can// zhes sogs tshigs bcad dang bcas pas gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol mo'i bar dang*/ gos zung 'bul ba dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum la sogs pa nas/ ba le na tsa ye swā hā'i bar gyis nang mchod dang*/ yid byung gi mchod pa rnams 'bul lo// bstod pa'ang bsdu na/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' gro ma// zhes pas bstod/

rgyas pa la spro na chag lo tsā bas mdzad pa dang*/ ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa la sogs pa gang rigs kyis bstod do// gtor ma dang po bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me sogs kyang mchod pa'i cho ga nas 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pas 'bul ba nas/ 'dod don zhu ba'i bar gyis phul la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ ces sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la srin lag gis thab kyi thal ba cung zad blangs te rang gi dpral bar thig le bya'o// gsum pa ni/ thab tu mar dgang gzar gang blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes pas me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams te/ de la yam shing la sogs pa'i rdzas kyi lhag ma ji ltar rigs pa phul ba'i mthar/ gong 'jig rten pa'i me lha byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum 'bul ba dang mchod bstod bya'o// gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs lan gsum gyis phul la/ me lha'i rgyal po khyod kyis ni// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces dang*/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed la/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// de nas rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /seng ge'i gdong can zhes sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam gang shes dang*/

phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis brjod cing*/ me tog gi char dbab pa dang*/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs la sogs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// me mnal ba dang thal ba mis ma 'gam par dor ba gal che'o// smras pa/ rdo rje gdan pa'i zhabs dang ḍā ki nī// rab dgyes zhal gyi ma dros las 'ongs pa'i// gdams pa ches zab sin+dhu'i chab kyi rgyun// brgyud 'dzin mkhyen pa'i sa la ci yang 'khyil// gzhan yang bka' dang zab gter gzhung mang las// sna tshogs las kyi 'dod pa rtag 'jo yang*// bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas rnams kyi las// stong pa'i mkha' la bos ltar lad mo med// de bsam don du gnyer 'gar phan bya'i phyir// zhi ba'i sreg blugs bris pa'i dge ba yis// don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub kyi// 'byung gnas yon tan rgya mtsho mngon gyur cig /ces pa gser chos kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi sreg blugs kyi cho ga ye shes me lce zhes bya ba 'di yang dge slong phun sum tshogs rgya mtsho'i ched du btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// gser chos kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can ma'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul gyi yi ge nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal gyi 'byung gnas bla ma dang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro dbyer med la// gus pas btud de dpal mo yi// bsnyen pa bya tshul cung zad bri// de la 'di'i rjes su gnang ba dang man ngag legs par thob pa'i gang zag gis/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can ma'i bsnyen pa bya ba la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes phan yon bstan pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis sam/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes gang yang rung bar gnas dben par sgrub pa po kha shar ram lhor phyogs pa dang bstun par 'byor na 'di nyid kyi sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du/

gtor ma gru gsum rtse mo ha cang rno ba ma yin pa smug rtsis byugs pa rgyan ldan dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi la zlum gtor gcig dang bcas pa bsham/ de'i mdun du nye bar spyod pa dang*/ nub dang po la dgos pa'i sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru la sogs pa'i nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa po stan la 'dug ste/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin gtibs pa ltar dpang por bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar gnas pa'i 'dun pa dang ma bral bas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma chab kyis bran pa la bsang sbyangs bya ba nas brtsams te/ gtor ma phyi rol du dor ba'i bar la phal cher bde mchog gam mkha' spyod kyi cho ga las 'byung ba ji lta ba bzhin du bya zhing*/ khyad par ni phrin las bcol ba'i skabs su/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i ched du bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin du bgyid par 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar chad thams cad srung ba dang zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba dang*/ drag sngags zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyi rjes su 'di'i gsang sngags aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥsogs kyang brjod cing gu gul gyis bdug go /de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ nub dang por nang mchod la dmigs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me sogs nas/ ha ho hrīḥ'i bar kho bos byas pa'i seng gdong ma mchod pa'i cho ga las 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs te gzhag go /de nas gnas dang yo byad rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor la/

oṃ sum+bha ni zhes sogs nas/ dharmā ra ṇi ta rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar yang sngar smos ma thag pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga ltar bya'o// de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la sogs pas mdzad pa gang mos kyi steng nas nyams su blang ste/ de'ang bzlas pa'i dmigs pa spyi 'gro tsam byed na sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ srung ba dang bzlog pa'i dmigs pa khyad par ba ni yi ge rnying pa rnams nas 'byung ba'am/ mchod pa'i cho ga nyid du bkod pa ltar bya'o// de'ang snga dro la sogs pa bsnyen pa'i skabs srung ba'i dmigs pa gtso bor bton nas/ thun gyi mthar bzlog pa'i dmigs bzlas cung zad re byas la dmod pa dor ba dang bstun la thal mo lan gsum brdab pa dang*/ khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings su sgrol zhes pa'i bar nyams su blang ngo*// gzhan du na bzlog pa dngos kyi dus ni dgongs mo nyi ma thal kar gtso che bar bshad do// thun bsdu ba na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsam zhing brjod do// dgongs thun la skabs 'dir gtor ma phul te/ de'ang gtor ma nang mchod dang chus sbyangs pa nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab bo// de nas thog mar kye rdo rje la sogs pa dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na sngon du de dag la phul/ de nas 'di nyid kyi gtor mgron bskyed pa ni/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma zhes sogs nas/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar rang nyid kyi khyad par dor ba ma gtogs sgrub thabs ltar bya zhing*/ bsdu na skad cig gis spyan drang ngo*// gang ltar yang thod pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ ḍā ki nī singha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul ba'i mthar/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas/

shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ḍā ki nī singha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra ya oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ yid pa 'dod pa kun 'grub shog ces pa'i bar gyis 'bul lo// de nas chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma dang 'brel na 'dir 'bul lo// gang ltar yang mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phul ba'i mthar/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ rten la brtan gzhug bya ba dang*/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gshegs su gsol ba rnams spyi ltar bya'o// de nas bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ la sogs pas gnas gsum bsrungs nas/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mthar brgyan pa dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ thun mtshams thams cad du'ang srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs pa'i nang du rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor rnams bya'o// de lta bu'i rigs pas thun gsum mam bzhi gang mos byas te/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni khri phrag drug la sogs pa gsungs kyang*/ thog ma'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bcu bzhi nges par mdzad pa phyag len no// de lta bu'i rim pas sngags kyi grangs song ba dang gsang sngags kyi nus pa 'byin pa dang*/ kha skong ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na logs su gsal ba ltar shes par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de lta bu'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas gzhung nas ji skad bshad pa'i las tshogs mtha' dag sgrub pa la dbang zhing*/ bye brag tu gzhan gyi byad kha la sogs pa'i gnod pa phyir bzlog pa'i thabs mchog tu 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// de ltar grangs med mkha' 'gro yi// gtso mo seng ge'i gdong pa can// ba ri lo tsā'i gser chos kyi// bsnyen pa bya tshul nyung gsal 'di// bris pa'i dge bas 'gro ba rnams// mi dang mi min nyer 'tshe las// rnam par rgyal nas mkha' 'gro'i gtso// dgyes pa'i zhal bzang ston par shog

/ces pa gser chos lugs kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can ma'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul gyi yi ge nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ don du gnyer ba'i dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i ched du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// //bha wan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
